svg.text: Weekly package downloads for each protocol, across npm, PyPI and crates.io
20 Jul to 11 Oct 2026. Each panel has its own scale, from 0 to its peak. The text under each panel gives the latest week by registry.
Per registry, the most downloaded package is counted. † = community or vendor implementation, not the protocol's own. CI and mirrors are included.

svg.text: Baselayer KYA: closed commercial product: no public repository or package.
AP2: The ap2 package on PyPI belongs to an unrelated project; no official npm or crates.io package found.
TAP: No package found on npm, PyPI or crates.io.
ANS: No package found on npm, PyPI or crates.io (Go reference implementation).
Other packages of the same registry, not added (a package and its dependencies would be counted twice)
Maven, NuGet, Go modules, RubyGems, container pulls, and copies installed without a registry.
Each registry gives a different history, so every panel covers the same 12 weeks.
